mods.name: Enemy Threat Overlay
mods.author: nikaakaa
mods.summary: Hold Space to light up every square the enemy can reach.
mods.description: A board overlay that shows enemy coverage while you hold the key, so you can see the trap before you walk into it. Rebind the key from the in-game console (F10).

mods.name: Gambit Creation API
mods.author: Ben
mods.summary: Library other mods use to build and register custom gambits.
mods.description: Not much to look at on its own - install it because another mod asked for it. It gives mod authors a small API for defining a gambit (art, rarity, trigger, effect) and registering it with the game at runtime.

mods.name: Kamikaze Gambit
mods.author: Ben
mods.summary: A custom gambit: trade your piece to take the one that took it.

mods.name: Mighty Kasparov Every Stage
mods.author: Minty
mods.summary: Faces the Mighty Kasparov boss on every stage. Yes, really.
mods.description: A difficulty mod for people who have finished the game and want to suffer. Ships disabled - flip it on in the manager when you are ready.

mods.name: Speed Mod
mods.author: Ben
mods.summary: Adds a Game Speed arrow row to the settings panel.
mods.description: Puts a speed control in the game's own settings screen so you can fast-forward the parts of a run you have already seen. Uses the framework's UI helpers, so it looks like it shipped with the game.

mods.name: Spikes' Gambit
mods.author: TGM
mods.summary: Enemies that step on TRAP tiles are captured instead of trapped.
